newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks end higher ahead of reform package.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks end higher ahead of reform package.

text.p: Pakistani stocks finished higher on Wednesday amid speculative buying ahead of an economic reform package likely to announced by Prime Minister Nawaz Sharif on Thursday, dealers said.
"The market has shrugged off the nervousness created by the suspension of the International Monetary Fund's standby loan," Muddassar Malik analyst at BMA Capital Management said.

The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index rose 36.89 points, or 2.32 percent, to close at 1,625.36. Gainers led losers 242 to 73. ICI Pakistan rose 1.15 rupees to 25.45 rupees and Hub Power 1.20 to 38.90. -- Ovais Subhani 9221-5685192
